prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, finished game-card illustration.
Image 1 is the CLEAN EDIT TARGET and the exact composition to preserve. Image 2 is the user's annotated copy of the same scene; its green arrows indicate ONLY the desired outward directions. They are instructions for motion, never visual elements of the final artwork.

Make ONE targeted improvement: make the enormous shockwave visibly PROPAGATE OUTWARD FROM THE BURNING ROBOT'S MID-TORSO, rather than reading as a static luminous hoop. Keep the existing gigantic cropped ellipse at exactly its established midbody / gun-mount height and perspective. Its left and right turning points remain outside the canvas. Do not shrink it, move it to the feet, add a ground circle, or zoom out.

Communicate the expansion with integrated illustrated motion:
- Add a readable fan of short, tapered, radial pressure streaks and flame tongues flowing from the abdominal burn source toward the existing outer wavefront, following the directions shown in image 2. On the near side they project toward the viewer and lower corners; on the sides they push left and right. They occupy the SAME tilted shockwave plane and obey its foreshortening. They must not spiral around the robot or converge inward.
- Give the pressure front a narrow, intensely lit leading lip and a translucent orange/ivory wake on its INNER side, toward the source. Sparse wispy inner trails taper back toward the torso. A few irregular flame cusps and hot gas curls stretch outward over the leading edge. This asymmetry should make the forward expansion legible in one still frame.
- Add a restrained scattering of glowing embers and small existing-type fragments carried radially OUTWARD. Their bright heads sit farther from the source, with short tapered motion trails pointing back inward. Keep them subordinate to the machine silhouette. Let a few outward-directed sparks pass across the existing ring to show hot pressure escaping into the surrounding space.
- Integrate thin, broken compressed-air contour strokes immediately behind the bright front. Keep the ring interior clear. These are local wake details of ONE shockwave, not extra complete concentric rings or an opaque energy disc.

Make the flow readable at small card size without covering the robot in dense radial lines or turning the effect into straight laser beams. Use a few strong, well-spaced accents across the sectors indicated by the user. Do not draw arrows, arrowheads, green marks, diagram lines, labels, UI, text, a border or watermark. Restore any area hidden by the green annotation using clean image 1.

Preserve the camera, crop, robot pose and scale, four legs, two lateral guns, two antennae, ivory and burgundy armor, torn panels, sustained attached flames, incandescent armor seams, charred edges, rolling smoke, two background robots, foreground burning wreckage, ruins, grass and blue sky. The machine must still look continuously BURNING with a sudden deflagration pulse, not merely a white detonation. Retain the exact ring scale and its front/back occlusion. Do not redesign or mirror any machine.
Match the established clean ink outlines and three-level cel shading. Preserve the existing colors; added hot accents use pale cream derived from #FEE4D9 / #D5C09C and warm orange derived from #EE9D58. Avoid unrelated new colors, whiteout bloom, heavy blur and a glowing spherical shield.
Return one opaque square finished illustration with only this outward-expansion improvement.
